about: Recorded sizes in bytes of the shipped engine binaries, checked by tools/binary-budget.py (issue 551). A binary may be at most `tolerance` above its budget. Start of the ratchet: the size table of issue 551 (main 2ff4472d2 + PR 540, macOS arm64; Wasm from the same build). Lower a budget with `tools/binary-budget.py check --update`; raise one only by hand, in a reviewed change that says why.
